name: fig-07
title: fig-07: Nested cellular hierarchy
confidence_basis: Held at Provisional. BASELINE (fig07-runnable) demonstrates nested routing through a deep place graph (behavioral verification). The MECHANISTIC VARIANT (fig07-mechanistic, scientific-review revision) adds the thing that makes nesting functional: permeable boundaries that causally gate a deep nuclear reporter (closing either boundary → reporter 0, series gating), conservative cross-compartment transport (Σsubstrate invariant to 1.3e-7), a verified first-principles prediction (higher permeability fills the deep compartment faster), and a locally-restricted cytoplasmic reaction that starves the nucleus — genuine mechanistic_ablation + prospective_prediction evidence that hierarchy influences function. Still Provisional because "depth" is a modeling choice (number of permeability barriers, not a physical length), the variant has four containment levels rather than the baseline's six place-graph depths, and no constant is calibrated to a measured compartment permeability or transport rate.
question: Does the paper's §Biomolecular compositions figure (Fig molecular_compositions) hold as an executable composite -- can molecular structures organized hierarchically across scales (proteins to complexes, organelles, ECM) be represented as a NESTED place graph, with processes that interact with those nested states corresponding to cellular compartments and structures, such that a process acting at one nesting level actually moves quantity in a deeply-nested store while the place-graph containment is preserved as the whole cell evolves as one coupled system?
biological_summary:
This is the runnable realization of the paper's §Biomolecular compositions figure (Fig molecular_compositions), whose two panels are: **a.** molecular structures organized hierarchically across scales -- from proteins to complexes, organelles, and extracellular matrix; and **b.** a composite process diagram in which processes interact with nested states corresponding to cellular compartments and structures. The paper's point is that complementarity organizes molecules into complexes and higher-level assemblies, and that as organization increases the model must carry the containment -- membranes, compartments, organelles -- as structure, not flatten it into a bag of species.

The `fig07-runnable` composite (`meta_modelers_guide.composites.fig07-runnable`) wires SIX ODE handlers over one place graph whose stores nest up to SIX levels deep (`cytoplasm -> nucleus -> chromosome -> chromatin -> nucleosome -> DNA`) WITHOUT flattening it, and a ribosome pool four levels deep (`cytoplasm -> organelles -> ribosomal_complex -> ribosome`). The handlers' outputs feed each other's inputs, so running the composite makes the whole hierarchy evolve as one coupled cell:

transmembrane transport -> cytoplasmic nutrients; metabolism -> metabolites + energy; transcription reads the DEEP nested DNA -> RNA; translation -> protein; subunit assembly grows the ribosome pool (closing the loop back to translation); replication / repair holds the DNA at its genome set point. Each process is wired to input/output paths that address stores buried inside the compartment hierarchy -- transcription and replication both read/write the DNA six levels down, translation and assembly read/write the ribosome pool four levels down -- so the place graph's containment is load-bearing, not decorative.

Over a fixed-seed deterministic 30-step run (31 emitted frames), the nested cascade propagates across every level: cytoplasmic nutrients rise 0 -> 9.0 (monotonic fill from the imported flux), metabolites 0 -> ~20.5 and energy 0 -> ~13.1, RNA 0 -> ~0.64 and protein 0 -> ~0.24 (protein trails RNA, as translation is downstream of transcription), and the four-levels-deep ribosome pool grows 0.5 -> ~0.88 past its bootstrap seed. The six-levels-deep genome is held at its set point (DNA == 1.0 throughout) by replication / repair -- a homeostatic hold, not drift. After the run the place-graph containment is intact: every intermediate container along the six-level chain is still a nested store, the deep DNA and ribosome leaves are still reachable at full depth, and the DNA leaf still sits nested alongside its untouched histone sibling. Every one of these numbers reproduces exactly run to run.

On the workbench catalog run -- the short 8-step window the dynamics figure and `scripts/_catalog/measured_readouts.json` snapshot (workbench 0.4.1) -- the same six processes are caught in the cascade's slow early phase, NOT a collapse. Transport has filled cytoplasmic nutrients to 2.4 and metabolism has made metabolites 1.5 and energy 0.84, while the downstream gene-expression products are still ramping up (rna 0 -> 0.18, proteins 0 -> 0.008) and subunit assembly has only nudged the ribosome pool off its 0.50 bootstrap seed (0.5000 -> 0.5007); the six-levels-deep DNA is held flat at its 1.0 set point throughout. Every downstream level is already moving in the right direction and simply has not yet accumulated -- the larger endpoints (nutrients 9.0, metabolites ~20.5, rna ~0.64, proteins ~0.24, ribosome ~0.88) develop over the composite's default 30-step horizon, which the behavior tests and the dynamics figure exercise. The slow downstream rates are a property of the short window, not a broken cascade.

This is a didactic / toy-real composite: the ODE rate constants, yields, and pool seeds are hand-chosen so the whole nested cascade is legible within 30 steps, not calibrated to a named cell type or literature target. Its role in the paper-figures investigation is to make Fig molecular_compositions **executable** -- to show that the nested-hierarchy-of-composites claim it draws is one a process-bigraph composite actually runs, with real processes acting on real deeply-nested stores.
claim: Wiring six ODE processes over one place graph whose stores nest up to six levels deep -- WITHOUT flattening the compartment hierarchy -- reproduces the paper's §Biomolecular compositions figure (Fig molecular_compositions) as a runnable nested cascade: over a deterministic 30-step run, a process acting at each nesting level moves quantity in its nested store (transport fills cytoplasmic nutrients 0 -> 9.0; metabolism makes metabolites 0 -> ~20.5 and energy 0 -> ~13.1; transcription reads the six-levels-deep DNA to make RNA 0 -> ~0.64; translation makes protein 0 -> ~0.24; subunit assembly grows the four-levels-deep ribosome pool 0.5 -> ~0.88, closing the loop; replication / repair holds the six-levels-deep genome at DNA == 1.0), and the place-graph containment is preserved as the dynamics run -- the deep stores stay nested inside their parents, reachable only at full depth, alongside their untouched siblings. The whole hierarchy evolves as one coupled cell; every value reproduces exactly run to run.

variants.name: fig07-mechanistic
variants.rationale: Real-mechanism upgrade (scientific-review revision, Oct 2026). The baseline fig07-runnable runs a cascade through a deep place graph, but — as the review notes — a deep scalar changing establishes nested ROUTING, not multilevel biological ORGANIZATION, and nothing makes the nesting FUNCTIONAL. This variant adds that: a genuinely nested place graph (environment ⊃ cell ⊃ cytoplasm ⊃ nucleus) with two PermeableBoundary processes (plasma membrane, nuclear envelope) that gate conservative passive transport, a locally-restricted cytoplasmic metabolism, and a nuclear reporter whose production depends on the substrate that reaches it. It makes the three hierarchical relations explicit (containment = nesting; part-of = the boundary that defines a compartment; regulatory = the reporter depends on its signal), defines depth biologically (the number of permeability barriers a signal must cross), and shows a boundary-level knob causally controlling a deep observable — lowering EITHER boundary's permeability shuts the nuclear reporter down (series gating). The baseline is kept intact as the didactic routing demonstration.

key_assumptions: This `fig07-runnable` composite is **didactic / toy-real**: a small, illustrative composite built to look like Fig molecular_compositions and play forward as a coupled nested cascade -- NOT calibrated to a named cell type, organism, or literature target. The ODE rate constants (transport k=0.3, metabolism k=0.25 with metabolite_yield=0.6 / energy_yield=0.4, assembly k=0.2), the transcription / translation kinetics (elongation rates, half-lives, Michaelis constants), and the initial pool seeds are hand-chosen so the whole hierarchy is legible within a 30-step run, not fitted values.

The processes are ODE handlers over dimensionless concentration / count / energy stores; "levels" here are place-graph nesting depths (compartment containment), not physical length scales. The six-level DNA path and four-level ribosome path are the load-bearing nesting the figure asserts; the exact depths are a modeling choice that mirrors the biological compartment hierarchy (cytoplasm > nucleus > chromosome > chromatin > nucleosome > DNA).

Products (nutrients, metabolites, energy, RNA, proteins) initialise empty and are MADE over the run from the environment-seeded driver pools (interstitial matrix, enzymes, genes, ribosomal subunits); the ribosome pool starts at a nonzero bootstrap seed (0.5) so translation has a nonzero rate at t=0. The DNA set point (dna_init=1.0) is the homeostatic target replication / repair holds, not a fitted copy number.

The composite is fully deterministic (fixed ODE integration, no stochasticity), so every emitted value and every final nested store value reproduces exactly run to run; the exact endpoints (nutrients 9.0, metabolites ~20.5, ribosome ~0.88) are regression pins tied to the current rate constants, while the DIRECTION of each (rise at every level, DNA held at set point, protein trailing RNA) is the a-priori structural prediction.
acceptance_criteria: The composite runs its default step count to completion and emits a clean trajectory (default_n_steps ticks + the initial emit) -- the figure is executable, not merely drawn.

A process acting at each nesting level moves quantity in its store: transport fills the cytoplasmic nutrient pool (monotonically, supply is on), metabolism makes metabolites and energy, transcription of the deeply-nested DNA makes RNA, translation makes protein (protein trailing RNA, as it is downstream), and subunit assembly grows the deeply-nested ribosome pool past its bootstrap seed.

The nested cascade propagates across MULTIPLE levels in one coupled run -- a non-trivial change occurs at every level (transport, metabolism, transcription, translation, assembly), not just at the seeded input.

The place-graph containment is PRESERVED as the dynamics run -- after a full run the six-level DNA chain and four-level ribosome chain are still nested stores reachable only at full depth, and the deep DNA leaf still sits nested alongside its untouched histone sibling (containment, not a flattened bag of species).

A process acting on a deeply-nested store moves the quantity IN that nested store: the four-levels-deep ribosome pool grows over the run and its final place-graph value equals the last emitted frame (same store), and the six-levels-deep genome is held at its set point by replication / repair (conserved within tolerance, never runs away).

units_and_time.time: 1 step = unspecified physical time (dimensionless model time); the run is 30 such steps (31 emitted frames including the initial emit).
units_and_time.quantities: nutrient / metabolite / RNA / protein / enzyme / gene stores are dimensionless concentration units; the ribosome and subunit pools are dimensionless counts; energy is a dimensionless energy unit; transport_flux is a dimensionless chemical-flux unit. No quantity carries a calibrated physical unit.
units_and_time.note: No quantity here is calibrated to a named cell type, organism, or literature target; "levels" are place-graph nesting depths, not physical length scales.

findings.statement: The nesting is made FUNCTIONAL, answering the review's objection that a deep scalar changing is only nested routing. In the mechanistic variant, permeable compartment boundaries causally gate a deep nuclear reporter: with both boundaries open the reporter reaches 8.23, but closing EITHER the plasma membrane OR the nuclear envelope (permeability → ε) drives it to exactly 0. Because the deep observable sits behind two boundaries in series, each level of the hierarchy is an independent functional gate — a boundary-level cause with a deep effect, not a redrawn container. findings.statement: The three hierarchical relations are explicit and distinct, and compartments do functionally different things. CONTAINMENT is the place-graph nesting (environment⊃cell⊃cytoplasm⊃nucleus); PART-OF is each boundary that defines a compartment (membrane/envelope); REGULATORY is the reporter depending on the signal that reaches it. A LOCALLY-RESTRICTED cytoplasmic metabolism consumes substrate only in the cytoplasm and thereby starves the downstream nucleus (reporter 13.0 with it off vs 1.49 on), and a localized cytoplasmic perturbation reaches the nucleus only when the envelope is open. Honest scope: this remains a didactic, uncalibrated model — "depth" means the number of permeability barriers crossed, not a physical length scale, and the variant has four containment levels (not the baseline's six place-graph depths); it demonstrates that hierarchy CAN influence function, not a validated multiscale organism. The calibrated cousin remains `biomolecular-complementarity` in draft-to-living-cell.

regression_compatibility.basis: fig07-runnable.composite.json builds and runs its default 30 steps to completion through the process-bigraph engine (tests/test_fig07_nested_dynamics.py, 8 tests), matching this investigation's convention for runnable figure composites.

biological_validation.basis: Reported in two layers, per the review. BEHAVIORAL / STRUCTURAL (baseline fig07-runnable): a process acting at each nesting level moves quantity in its store, the cascade propagates across all levels, and the place-graph containment is preserved after the run. These establish nested ROUTING — a deep scalar changing — which is implementation verification, NOT evidence that hierarchy influences function. MECHANISTIC (variant fig07-mechanistic): permeable boundaries causally gate a deep nuclear reporter (closing EITHER boundary → reporter 0; series gating; mechanistic_ablation), transport is conservative (invariant), a more permeable boundary fills the deep compartment faster (prospective_prediction), and a locally-restricted cytoplasmic reaction starves the nucleus. This is genuine evidence that the hierarchy INFLUENCES FUNCTION. NOT yet biological validation of a multiscale organism — the depths are a modeling choice and the constants are uncalibrated; that rigor is the sibling `biomolecular-complementarity` in draft-to-living-cell.

explanatory_gain.basis: Realizing Fig molecular_compositions as a runnable composite -- six real processes acting on stores buried up to six levels deep in a preserved place graph -- makes the paper's nested-hierarchy-of-composites claim concrete and executable: the figure's two panels (hierarchical molecular structures; a composite process diagram over nested compartment states) are not merely drawn but run forward as one coupled cell, with the compartment containment load-bearing rather than flattened.

conclusion:
## Claims
- Wiring six ODE processes over one place graph nesting up to six levels deep -- WITHOUT flattening the compartment hierarchy -- reproduces the paper's §Biomolecular compositions figure (Fig molecular_compositions) as a runnable nested cascade. Over a deterministic 30-step run, a process acting at each nesting level moves quantity in its store (transport 0 -> 9.0 nutrients; metabolism 0 -> ~20.5 metabolites and 0 -> ~13.1 energy; transcription of the six-levels-deep DNA 0 -> ~0.64 RNA; translation 0 -> ~0.24 protein, trailing RNA; assembly 0.5 -> ~0.88 on the four-levels-deep ribosome pool, closing the loop). All five levels change; every value reproduces exactly.
- The place-graph containment is PRESERVED as the dynamics run -- after the run the six-level DNA chain and four-level ribosome chain are still nested stores reachable only at full depth, and the DNA leaf still sits nested alongside its untouched histone sibling. A process acting on a deeply-nested store moves the quantity IN that store: the deep ribosome pool grew (final store == last emitted frame) and the deep genome was held at its set point (DNA == 1.0) by replication / repair.

## Evidence
- **COMPOSITE-RUNS-AND-EMITS** -- 31 frames (30 ticks + initial emit), final time == 30.0
- **TRANSPORT-FILLS-CYTOPLASMIC-NUTRIENTS** -- nutrients 0.0 -> 9.0, monotonic
- **METABOLISM-MAKES-METABOLITES-AND-ENERGY** -- metabolites 0.0 -> ~20.5, energy 0.0 -> ~13.1
- **CENTRAL-DOGMA-TRANSCRIPTION-AND-TRANSLATION-RISE** -- rna 0.0 -> ~0.64, proteins 0.0 -> ~0.24, rna leads protein
- **ASSEMBLY-GROWS-RIBOSOME-POOL-CLOSING-THE-LOOP** -- ribosome 0.5 -> ~0.88 past its seed
- **CASCADE-PROPAGATES-ACROSS-MULTIPLE-LEVELS** -- all five levels change
- **PLACE-GRAPH-CONTAINMENT-PRESERVED** -- six-level DNA chain + four-level ribosome chain intact, DNA nested beside histone
- **PROCESS-MOVES-QUANTITY-IN-DEEP-NESTED-STORE** -- deep ribosome grew and == emitted last frame; deep DNA held at set point 1.0

## Limitations
- This fig07-runnable composite is didactic / toy-real -- the ODE rate constants, yields, and pool seeds are hand-chosen so the whole nested cascade is legible within 30 steps, not calibrated to a named cell type, organism, or literature target.
- "Levels" are place-graph nesting depths (compartment containment), not physical length scales; the exact depths mirror the biological compartment hierarchy but are a modeling choice.
- The calibrated cousin for the molecular-complementarity narrative is `biomolecular-complementarity` in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation; this study does not restate its numbers.

limitations: This fig07-runnable composite is didactic / toy-real -- the ODE rate constants (transport k=0.3, metabolism k=0.25, assembly k=0.2), yields, transcription / translation kinetics, and initial pool seeds are hand-chosen so the whole nested cascade is legible within a 30-step run, not fitted to a named cell type, organism, or literature target. The exact endpoint magnitudes (nutrients 9.0, metabolites ~20.5, ribosome ~0.88) are regression pins tied to those constants; the per-level direction and the containment claim are the a-priori structural predictions.

"Levels" here are place-graph nesting depths (compartment containment), not physical length scales; the six-level DNA path and four-level ribosome path mirror the biological compartment hierarchy (cytoplasm > nucleus > chromosome > chromatin > nucleosome > DNA) but the exact depths are a modeling choice.

The processes are ODE handlers over dimensionless concentration / count / energy stores; no quantity carries a calibrated physical unit, and there is no spatial, stochastic, or rule-based molecular detail -- the figure''s molecular-structure panel is represented by named nested stores, not by explicit binding sites or conformations.

Two run horizons appear in this study and must not be conflated: the behavior tests and the dynamics figure exercise the composite's default 30-step horizon (the full cascade: nutrients 9.0, metabolites ~20.5, ribosome ~0.88), while the workbench 0.4.1 catalog readout (`fig07-executable`) is a short 8-step window that catches the same cascade in its slow early phase (nutrients 2.4, rna 0.18, proteins 0.008, ribosome ~0.50). The small downstream values at 8 steps are the short window, not a broken or collapsing cascade.

The rigorous molecular-complementarity cousin is `biomolecular-complementarity` in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation; this study is the executable-figure counterpart and does not restate that cousin''s numbers as its own.

Mechanistic variant (fig07-mechanistic) — scope and honest limits: it demonstrates that hierarchy CAN influence function (permeable boundaries gate a deep observable, series gating, conservative transport, compartment-restricted metabolism), fixing the baseline's routing-only limitation. But "depth" here means the number of permeability barriers a signal crosses, NOT a physical length scale; the variant has four containment levels (environment/cell/cytoplasm/nucleus), not the baseline's six place-graph depths; the boundary is passive diffusion (no active transport, channels, or gating kinetics); and every constant (permeability, metabolism rate, reporter kinetics) is didactic — not calibrated to a measured membrane permeability or transport rate. It shows a mechanism, not a validated multiscale cell.
falsifiability: Overturned if the composite fails to run its default step count to completion, if any level fails to change over the run (a mis-wired process), if protein leads RNA or the ribosome pool fails to grow past its seed, if the DNA set point drifts away from 1.0, if the run is not deterministic across repeated runs of the same composite, or if the place-graph containment is not preserved after the run (a nested path flattened, or a deep store no longer reachable at full depth).

visualizations.name: Figure 7 · the paper's process-bigraph diagram (panel b)

config.caption: The paper's panel-b diagram — the cell's structural composition as a place graph (extracellular matrix, membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, organelles) with the processes that act across levels.

Baseline (didactic smoke test): the simpler pre-revision hierarchy (fig07-runnable), kept as the executable baseline. Six ODE processes act on stores up to SIX levels deep in one place graph and feed each other, so the whole cell evolves as one coupled system — transmembrane transport fills the cytoplasmic nutrient pool, metabolism makes metabolites + energy, transcription reads the deeply-nested DNA into RNA, translation makes protein, subunit assembly grows the ribosome pool, replication holds DNA at its set point. What to look for: the cascade propagating across every level. (This baseline shows depth exists and couples; the mechanistic figure below shows depth INFLUENCES FUNCTION via permeable boundaries.)

Mechanistic (the decisive figure): a nested hierarchy whose permeable boundaries gate a deep observable, so depth influences function rather than merely routing a scalar. (A) the nested compartments (environment ⊃ cell ⊃ cytoplasm ⊃ nucleus) with the substrate port path crossing the plasma membrane and nuclear envelope — containment = nesting, boundary = part-of, reporter-depends-on-signal = regulatory. (B) substrate propagates inward level by level and the deep nuclear reporter rises. (C) a first-principles prediction: a more permeable membrane fills the deep compartment faster (nuclear substrate at t=8 monotone in P_mem). (D) series gating — closing EITHER boundary (ε) zeroes the deep reporter, so each depth is a functional gate. (E) the locally-restricted cytoplasmic metabolism starves the nucleus. (F) a localized cytoplasmic pulse reaches the nucleus only if the envelope is open. Hierarchy here INFLUENCES FUNCTION, not merely routes a scalar. From scripts/build_fig07_mechanistic.py.

experiment: Run the `fig07-runnable` composite (six ODE handlers -- transmembrane transport, metabolism, transcription, translation, subunit assembly, replication / repair -- over one place graph nesting up to six levels deep) to completion over its default 30 steps through the process-bigraph engine, and measure whether a process acting at each nesting level moves quantity in its nested store, whether the cascade propagates across every level as one coupled cell, and whether the place-graph containment is preserved as the dynamics run.
result: Over a deterministic 30-step run (31 emitted frames), a process acting at each nesting level moves quantity in its store: transmembrane transport fills the cytoplasmic nutrient pool 0 -> 9.0 (monotonic), metabolism makes metabolites 0 -> ~20.5 and energy 0 -> ~13.1, transcription of the six-levels-deep DNA makes RNA 0 -> ~0.64, translation makes protein 0 -> ~0.24 (trailing RNA, as it is downstream), and subunit assembly grows the four-levels-deep ribosome pool 0.5 -> ~0.88, closing the loop back to translation. All five levels change in one coupled run. The place-graph containment is preserved as the dynamics run: after the run every intermediate container along the six-level DNA chain is still a nested store, the deep DNA and ribosome leaves are reachable only at full depth, and the DNA leaf still sits nested alongside its untouched histone sibling. A process acting on a deeply-nested store moves the quantity IN that store -- the deep ribosome pool grew (final store == last emitted frame) and the deep genome was held at its set point (DNA == 1.0) by replication / repair. Every value reproduces exactly run to run. The paper's §Biomolecular compositions figure (Fig molecular_compositions) is thus executable, not merely drawn -- its nested hierarchy of composites runs forward as one coupled cell. This is a didactic / toy-real composite; the calibrated molecular-complementarity cousin is `biomolecular-complementarity` in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation.

biological_validation.basis: Reported in two layers, per the review. BEHAVIORAL / STRUCTURAL (baseline fig07-runnable): a process acting at each nesting level moves quantity in its store, the cascade propagates across all levels, and the place-graph containment is preserved after the run. These establish nested ROUTING — a deep scalar changing — which is implementation verification, NOT evidence that hierarchy influences function. MECHANISTIC (variant fig07-mechanistic): permeable boundaries causally gate a deep nuclear reporter (closing EITHER boundary → reporter 0; series gating; mechanistic_ablation), transport is conservative (invariant), a more permeable boundary fills the deep compartment faster (prospective_prediction), and a locally-restricted cytoplasmic reaction starves the nucleus. This is genuine evidence that the hierarchy INFLUENCES FUNCTION. NOT yet biological validation of a multiscale organism — the depths are a modeling choice and the constants are uncalibrated; that rigor is the sibling `biomolecular-complementarity` in draft-to-living-cell.

derived.insight: Six ODE processes wired over one place graph nesting up to six levels deep -- WITHOUT flattening the compartment hierarchy -- run to completion as one coupled cell and drive a non-trivial change at EVERY level of the nested hierarchy. A process acting at each level moves quantity in its store: transport fills cytoplasmic nutrients (0 -> 9.0, monotonic), metabolism makes metabolites (0 -> ~20.5) and energy (0 -> ~13.1), transcription of the six-levels-deep DNA makes RNA (0 -> ~0.64), translation makes protein (0 -> ~0.24, trailing RNA), and subunit assembly grows the four-levels-deep ribosome pool (0.5 -> ~0.88, closing the loop). All five levels change; every value is deterministic and reproduces exactly run to run.
